# 金剛童子持念經

**ID:** T1224
**Volume:** T21
**Category:** 密教部類
**Original Category:** 密教部
**Date:** 838
**Juans:** 1
**CBETA:** https://cbetaonline.dila.edu.tw/zh/T1224

## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A one-fascicle anonymous (失譯) ritual manual on **Vajra-Kumāra** 金剛童子, the wrathful Vajra-Youth treated above in [KR6j0449](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0449), [KR6j0450](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0450), and [KR6j0451](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0451). The Taishō header carries no translator-attribution and no compositional date, and the canwww entry (T21N1224) likewise records no responsible-statement other than 失譯 (translator unknown) and no Korean *Tripiṭaka* parallel — placing it in the broad layer of un-attributed Esoteric Chinese-language ritual manuals that accumulated around the central Vajra-Kumāra cycle.

**Abstract**

The text gives an abbreviated **持念** (Skt. *japa* / "maintained-recitation") manual: visualisation of Vajra-Kumāra, his *mudrā* and seed-syllable, the dhāraṇī to be recited, and the standard ritual sequence (purification → invocation → recitation → dismissal). It functions as a practitioner's compact handbook complementary to the longer doctrinal-and-ritual treatments in [KR6j0449](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0449) (T1222a) and [KR6j0451](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6j/KR6j0451) (T1223). Because the text is anonymous, dated only by its inclusion in the Tang-Sòng canonical collections of the Vajra-Kumāra cycle, the dating bracket given here is conservative (Sui–Late Tang).
